text:
Nora T: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp started throwing 400s from /rerank during a smoke test. Error: "embedding.length mismatch".
Jae H: repro notes?
Nora T: We batch ~7 vectors in Node. Intermittent auth refresh causes the retry path to re-send the same request body. Turns out we're using TypedArray.subarray in the batch helper and another routine later mutates the underlying buffer. One vector ends up 1535 instead of 1536.
Ibrahim A: that explains why python tests never hit it — lists vs views. Which SDK version?
Nora T: node-sdk@0.9.3 in latest sampleapp. Snippet:
```
const batches = chunk(vecs, 8)
await Promise.all(batches.map(b => sendBatch(b)))
// sendBatch may enqueue original body on 401 retry
```
Jae H: quick patch: clone buffers before enqueue. I pushed a tiny change in the sampleapp that copies each vector when building retry entries. CI green.
Ibrahim A: medium fix: retry middleware should deep-clone request bodies or mark them immutable to avoid any helper-specific bugs. Long-term: add SDK lint to warn about using subarray for request payloads.
Nora T: also noticed the API response isn't very actionable. `embedding.length mismatch` without which batch index made debugging slow.
Platform APIs: We can include metadata fields in the error envelope: batch_index, expected_dim, got_dim. We'll add it to the next minor release and keep backward compatibility.
Jae H: added an integration test that simulates 401->retry with concurrent batch mutations. Also added E2E parity check against python sampleapp.
CI Bot: sampleapp fix merged — pipeline passed ✅
Nora T: temporary workaround: set SAMPLEAPP_BATCH_RETRY=off for onboards until middleware fix lands.
Ibrahim A: I'll file follow-ups: 1) retry middleware change, 2) SDK lint rule, 3) API error improvement, 4) add note in onboarding docs about not reusing subarray for retriable bodies.
Nora T: thanks everyone — leaving link to the issue in the sampleapp README.
